questions.question: Name two of the most common types of voltage regulators.
questions.idealAnswer: Carbon pile regulators and the three-unit regulators.

questions.question: Explain how a carbon pile voltage regulator works.
questions.idealAnswer: It is a type of regulator used with high-output DC generators. Field current is controlled by varying the resistance of a stack of thin carbon disks. The resistance is varied by controlling the amount the stack is compressed by a spring whose force is opposed by the pull of an electromagnet.
